d: On November 4, 2026, the Union Cabinet approved a proposal extending the engagement period of Agniveers by two years. Chief of Defence Staff General N.S. Raja Subramani confirmed 25% of Agniveers will be absorbed into regular armed forces after four years based on merit. The remaining 75% will be offered an additional two years of service, after which unselected recruits face return to civilian life without government job reservations.
